summary: Code scanning AI Scan for pull requests is now generally available. It complements CodeQL by finding vulnerabilities in pull request changes for languages and frameworks that CodeQL does not currently cover, including PHP, Shell/Bash, Terraform configuration (HCL), Dockerfiles, JSP for Java, Blazor for C#, and more.
takeaways: A GitHub Copilot license is not required.
For private and internal organization-owned repositories, GitHub Code Security or GitHub Advanced Security is required.
AI Credit usage is displayed in the “AI usage” section of enterprise billing and licensing as the “Advanced Security” product.
